_what: What each run's number means, from looking at the pictures (2026-10-05). A case is 'fair' when both engines drew the same thing.

notes.post-ao: three.js draws screen-space AO (visible); Godot's web renderer (Compatibility) draws none: its number is the base scene's.
notes.lights-32: three.js shows the coloured pools of 32 point lights; Godot's web build shows none and its draw count is unchanged: not drawn.
notes.lights-8: As lights-32: Godot's web build shows no point-light pools.
notes.post-bloom: Godot's glow blows the picture to white: not yet calibrated to three's.
notes.material-physical: No clearcoat visible in Godot's web build.
notes.physics-500: Both step at 60 Hz; physics_ms is the time of one step: Rapier (WASM) in three.js, Godot's own physics in Godot.
notes.base: Brightness differs (light units are calibrated differently); the work is the same.

sizes.godot-web: index.wasm 39.5 MB + index.js 0.28 MB + the pack
